logp.method_description: Aqueous solution of Ru(II) complex (5 mL, 10 μM) was mixed well with n-octanol (5 mL) in a 15mL centrifuge tube. The tube was wrapped in aluminum foil, shaken for 24 h in a thermostatic shaker incubator, and allowed to settle until the two phases were completely separated. The oil and water distribution coefficient log Po/w was calculated using the relative concentrations of Ru(II) complex in the two phases.[8] The minimum absorbance was set as 0.005. For absorbance below 0.005, it is used as < 0.005 for log Po/w calculation. The error of log Po/w is ± 0.04
